simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פּוּרָה (H6333) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.

simple.summary: פּוּרָה (pûwrâh) means a wine-press (as crushing the grapes) First listed occurrence: Hag 2 16.

definitions.full: H6333. puwrah מּוּרָה noun feminine wine-press ; — ׳פ דָּרַכְתִּי Isa 63:3 (see דָּרַךְ 3 ; distinguished from יֶקֶב , and perhaps part of it, Hag 2:16 (reading ׳מִמּ , so Sm Now; usually measure of juice from one filling of the ׳פ , see Ke).
